name: alt-drag-duplicate-simple
description: FEAT-B: Alt/Option-drag a selected item to duplicate it and drag the copy, leaving the original in place. Flag-gated pro-tier check (off in Simple, on in Pro), then drives the real DragController onMove/onUp with REAL pointermove/pointerup DOM events dispatched on window (the exact listeners DragController registers) after seeding `dragDuplicatePending` via `startDrag(..., duplicateSourceIds)` — mirroring what Furniture.tsx's onPointerDown computes once `shouldDuplicateOnDragStart` returns true (the real mesh pointerdown can't be triggered headlessly, per the playbook's R3F-raycast limitation; this is the same pattern furniture-drag-multitouch.json uses for BUG-1). Asserts the clone is created lazily on the first real move (not at drag-start), the original never moves, one undo step covers both, and a plain click that never moves duplicates nothing.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13)

steps.name: assert-flag-off-in-simple
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState();if(s.uiMode!=='simple')throw new Error('expected default Simple mode, got '+s.uiMode);if(s.featureFlags.altDragDuplicate!==false)throw new Error('altDragDuplicate should be forced OFF in Simple mode')})()

steps.name: assert-flag-on-in-pro
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState();if(s.featureFlags.altDragDuplicate!==true)throw new Error('altDragDuplicate should be ON in Pro mode')})()

steps.name: assert-one-item-before
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState();if(s.items.length!==1)throw new Error('expected 1 item before the alt-drag, got '+s.items.length)})()

steps.name: assert-pending-armed-not-resolved
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState();if(s.dragDuplicatePending!==true)throw new Error('dragDuplicatePending should be armed');if(s.dragIsDuplicate!==false)throw new Error('should not be resolved yet — no pointermove fired');if(s.items.length!==1)throw new Error('a click that never moves must not clone anything yet')})()

steps.name: assert-plain-click-duplicated-nothing
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState();if(s.items.length!==1)throw new Error('FEAT-B REGRESSION: a plain Alt+click that never moved duplicated an item — items.length='+s.items.length);if(s.draggingItemId!==null)throw new Error('drag did not end on the no-move release')})()

steps.name: assert-duplicate-pending-armed
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState();if(s.dragDuplicatePending!==true)throw new Error('dragDuplicatePending should be armed after startDrag with duplicateSourceIds');if(s.items.length!==1)throw new Error('the clone must not exist before the first real move')})()

steps.name: assert-clone-created-original-untouched
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState();if(s.items.length!==2)throw new Error('expected the clone to exist after the first real pointermove, got '+s.items.length+' items');const original=s.items.find(i=>i.id==='feat-b-sofa');if(!original)throw new Error('the original item vanished');if(original.position[0]!==window.__featB_pos0[0]||original.position[1]!==window.__featB_pos0[1])throw new Error('FEAT-B REGRESSION: the ORIGINAL moved — expected it to stay at '+JSON.stringify(window.__featB_pos0)+' but got '+JSON.stringify(original.position));if(!s.dragIsDuplicate)throw new Error('dragIsDuplicate should be true once resolved');if(s.draggingItemId==='feat-b-sofa')throw new Error('the drag should now target the CLONE, not the original');const clone=s.items.find(i=>i.id===s.draggingItemId);if(!clone)throw new Error('could not find the clone being dragged');if(clone.position[0]===window.__featB_pos0[0]&&clone.position[1]===window.__featB_pos0[1])throw new Error('the clone did not move away from the spawn point yet')})()

steps.name: assert-drop-is-valid
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState();if(s.dragValid!==true)throw new Error('the alt-drag copy landed on an invalid spot — pick a different move target so the demo shows a real committed duplicate')})()

steps.name: assert-pending-edit-two-items
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState();if(s.items.length!==2)throw new Error('expected 2 items after the alt-drag-duplicate release, got '+s.items.length);if(!s.pendingEdit)throw new Error('expected a pendingEdit (tick/cross confirm) for the successful duplicate+move')})()

steps.name: assert-final-two-items-one-undo-away
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState();if(s.items.length!==2)throw new Error('expected 2 items committed, got '+s.items.length);if(s.pendingEdit)throw new Error('pendingEdit should be cleared after confirm');const original=s.items.find(i=>i.id==='feat-b-sofa');if(original.position[0]!==window.__featB_pos0[0]||original.position[1]!==window.__featB_pos0[1])throw new Error('the original moved during confirm')})()

steps.name: assert-one-undo-removes-duplicate-and-move
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState();if(s.items.length!==1)throw new Error('FEAT-B REGRESSION: one undo should remove BOTH the duplicate and the move, got '+s.items.length+' items');if(s.items[0].id!=='feat-b-sofa')throw new Error('the surviving item should be the original')})()
